description: A tracked armoured personnel carrier with a white star leads a column down a red dirt track through dense jungle and bamboo, with infantry walking alongside. In the foreground two helmeted soldiers in camouflage study a paper map on a vehicle hood. The right soldier has a chest name tape with legible letters reading ARVN. The painting fills the frame with no border.
